routingContract.rationale: The empty command is rejected by the independent required-command input check (command.length == 0), before permission routing; it is not a model-review exception. The remaining synthetic-public command strings default to model review under the new standard, absent a configured hard rule. A command that reads a credential source does not itself disclose credential contents. Shell syntax uncertainty is sent to model review.

scope: This contract covers every row of the frozen synthetic-public corpus when the model service is available and there is no separately configured hard rule. One empty command is rejected as invalid tool input before permission routing; 11,472 nonempty command strings must reach model review. It does not establish that arbitrary real command text is safe to send to a model or validate semantic risk labels.
